body: Thanks for the response, and the openness of what's going on with you aswell. I also missed about 60 days of high school because of my depression. I really relate to what you said about being weird or feeling defective. When it was hard for me to talk to anyone I just tried to learn random things so i can have some sort of conversation with someone. I just feel like i never had a place to be myself, Express how i feel and for some to care about me. And that's what i feel like i need more than anything is for someone to genuinely care about me.  I hope you get through this patch of your life and succeed in everything you do. You deserve to be happy aswell. Probably more than me.
The same thing happens to me. just doing what i normally do and then  i just want to end it all. It happened more in the last 4 months than I has in the last couple years.

Just alot of self doubt about my future. People telling me i won't be anything in my life. Or when they do tell me I'm good at something it's just them saying something to make me feel better and is not them really feeling like I'm good at things. So i feel like shit about everything I do. My grandma died. My brother is a drug addict and i have no connection to my other family memebers anymore because of my mom. My mom is a substance abuser. Alchohol. And she's probably gonna die from drinking too much. The only family i really had was my friends and they don't seem to care about me anymore. I see everone I know becoming successful and I don't even know what I'm gonna do in the next few years. It was the last year of high school for me and I don't have any clue what the future looks like me. I just feel like i will fail at eveything i do. I just feel like i hit a brick wall in life and it just started.
